title: BirdCLEF 2026 priors research
subtitle: Pseudo-cache hour priors + Perch calibration + missing-class strategy
description:
Five CSV tables derived from local analysis of the BC2026 pseudo-cache + labeled soundscape data:

1. **pseudo_hour_priors.csv** (24 x 234) — per-hour species expectation, alone gives 0.896 macro-AUC on labeled OOF (leave-one-site-out honest).
2. **pseudo_site_hour_priors.csv** (120 x 234) — joint (site, hour) priors.
3. **pseudo_site_priors.csv** (21 x 234) — per-site species expectation.
4. **perch_calibration.csv** (234 rows) — Perch v2 systematic per-class bias ratios. Perch under-predicts 517063/24321 frogs by 100x and over-predicts compot1/compau/fepowl nightjars by 80x. Use log(ratio) as a logit shift.
5. **missing_class_strategy.csv** (28 rows) — per-class recovery strategy for the 28 BC2026 classes that have no train_audio (25 insect sonotypes + 3 frogs). Strategies: USE_PERCH (3 classes), USE_HOURLY_PRIOR (5), BROADCAST_FROM(anchor) (20).

Validated on Bruce Wu's 739-row labeled OOF benchmark — Bruce + 3*log(hour_prior) achieves macro-AUC 0.9586 from a 0.9304 baseline (+0.028).

See inference_notebooks/README.md in the source repo for usage.
